name: Cursed station
detailed_description:
Step into a world of confusion and uncertainty, where every station might be real or an illusion. In this psychological horror journey, your task is to determine which stations are genuine and which are cursed by strange anomalies. The clues are hidden, and you must piece them together to avoid falling into the endless cycle of false stations. Every wrong decision sends you back to square one, forcing you to rethink and reassess. Your only hope lies in discovering the truth before it traps you forever.

Key Features:

  • Psychological Journey: Immerse yourself in a dark, moody world filled with unsettling isolation. It's not about fear it's about the quiet tension of being alone and uncertain.

  • Anomalies and Perception: The smallest details reveal the truth. Trust your senses if something seems out of place, it’s your clue. The ability to notice these anomalies is essential for survival.

  • Exploration of Distorted Reality: Navigate through hauntingly quiet train stations that blur the line between reality and illusion. Every station feels slightly off, keeping you on edge as you search for the truth.

  • Progress Through Memory: Your journey relies on your ability to remember and discern the truth from the lies. Each failure brings you back to the start, but with every step, you edge closer to escaping the cycle.

  • Station 10 as the Anchor: Always begin in Station 10, the only real station. It’s your guide, your anchor, helping you spot anomalies and find your way through the maze of false stations.

short_description: Warning: You are one station away from descending into an endless loop of anomalies, where every decision could trap you in an unending cycle. What appears to be progress may only lead you back to the beginning, testing your perception and resolve with every station you pass.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 710 / Intel HD 4600 / AMD Radeon R5 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
